text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I knew it!
I had a feeling you'd already be training!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Did you need something?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: "First, from you—from you, whose back I've been chasing all this time—I want to hear what you have to say!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, do you remember?!
What you said to me after my debut—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: "If it's you... I know you'll be completely fine."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Back then, how could you...
how could you say for certain that everything would be okay?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
You don't hear the 'Voice of Destiny.'
You shouldn't even know what the future holds. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Another shift.
I see...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally, I had faith in your abilities.
However—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —That "absolute" is a responsibility... that I owe to you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Responsibility...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah.
As someone who had no small influence on them.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"I have—the duty to give you strength.
So that you may believe."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
—Think. And... fulfill it.
...The fate that was bestowed upon you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: This heavy feeling in my chest... Is this responsibility?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: How... can I fulfill that?

—*Munch*... *nom nom nom*.
Hehehe~♪

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!
I feel like it's destiny!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
—How to fulfill one's responsibility, huh...?
That's quite difficult, isn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Spe, you're an inspiration to Cesario!
She told me before—
she really looks up to your running!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"There must've been times when you encouraged someone too, right?
What did you do back then?!"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh!? Um...
Ah, I think I cheered with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I knew from experience... with so many expectations placed on me,
that everyone's support truly gives you strength.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I did the same thing.
So I could give strength to the girls who look up to me.
—I cheered with all my might!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...I see, cheering them on works too.
That's another way to do it, huh."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! I'll keep that in mind!!
—Next is over theeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Epi-san!?
...Was that really okay just now?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"...That's right! To Epi-san too...
Good luuuuck!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Next up is right hereeeee!!
—A café!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I just remembered! You've been surrounded
by a ton of juniors lately, haven't you!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: How are you taking responsibility for those children?!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
…………Um,
could you explain what's going on first?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
“—What I strive to do...
is bring out the strengths that are unique to each girl.”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That sounds awesome!
...Wait, but how!?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...It's difficult, you see. Since I tailor my advice
to each individual girl...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but... that's just it. In other words...
I try not to fixate on...
what I myself 'want to do.'

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Discovering what each person excels at... I consider that my responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone's so amazing.
While I'm just...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
!
This is...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh!!
Incredible!! What a magnificent tone!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha, thanks.
...Whoa?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Hm? What's that??
(Rustle, rustle... Caw, caw—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, you know, birds...
their way of flying differs depending on the species."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
All a parent does is help awaken their instinct...
In other words—everyone learns to fly on their own.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...*yawn*
Where should I hang my hammock tonight...?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Flying on its own, huh.
There really are so many different forms out there.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
…………As for me.
What I need to do is……――

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I want to find the answer by your side.
Would you keep me company on a walk?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It sure is quiet!
It's rare to see this place totally empty!
choice_data_list: It's the end of training camp, after all... makes sense.
Since training camp just ended... understandable.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
“Yeah. But usually...
everyone keeps working hard much later than this.”

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Same goes for the girls who looked up to me.
So that their hard work pays off...
I want to lead them toward the light!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Still.
...I'm scared.

Epiphaneia murmured and stopped in her tracks.
As if confirming the weight of the responsibility that had begun to sprout...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Kris S, Spe, Cafe, Stego...
Each of them was different in their own way.
Yet all of them—bore their responsibilities squarely.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Still, I... I can't do it just yet. Not having certainty—it terrifies me.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Back when I was certain destiny loved me,
I never would have thought of something like this.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I never knew until now...
just how weak I really was.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Are you scared too, Trainer?
A single word from me could lead to something critical. Guiding someone is truly that significant a responsibility.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Then how did you
face this fear?
choice_data_list: Believing in yourself, saying "I can definitely do this!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"It's... thanks to the voice of destiny.
Because that voice was there, I...—"
choice_data_list: But you chose every step of the way yourself
But you chose every step of the way yourself

text_block_list.text:
Precisely because no voice was there, it proves it.
Epiphaneia... by her own will, her own power, and
her own intuition――has moved toward a better path.
choice_data_list: What was spread out before you after you made your choice?
What was spread out before you after you made your choice?

text_block_list.text:
What are the odds that every path one chooses leads to wonderful results?
Having accomplished that, she is undeniably—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"...If that is the case, I can guide them.
As long as I have conviction, I...—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer.
I'm heading out.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
If I truly am beloved by destiny—
then I should be able to reach that dazzling sight!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I'll take it back there!!
My belief... in myself...!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah!
Wait for me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry! I'll reach it! 
If it's me, I definitely—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: You've gotta be kidding me...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'm fine!!
Trainer taught me. I am—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I am loved by destiny!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Everything you wish for—can come true!!!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOO!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
――Aah... twinkling.
The stars... are shining...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: The heavens are—blessing me!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...I feel it.
Surging forth—the power of destiny!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
That's right! Destiny loves me!
Every path I choose is blessed!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
And I, too... shall love it now!
The destiny that is myself—and the entire journey!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I will *definitely*
make my dream come true!!
As I looked up at the sky, thinking of Epiphaneia... one single star shone brighter than all the rest.
As if she had been born this very moment.
